marta: FYI scheduling a driver+firmware sweep for us-east GPU racks Sat 2025-01-18 03:00-05:00 UTC. This is a rolling driver update (CUDA errata) that requires node reboot. Impact: short task eviction and brief connection churn.
kai: What's our strategy for keeping capacity stable? last sweep caused a few long tails.
diego: Proposal: do targeted cordon of non-critical pools first (preemptible & spot), then stagger reserved pools with a 15m offset. We'll keep a hot reserve of 10 nodes in us-east-hot for premium workloads.
anna: We should also flip BGP prep routes for external egress to prefer the secondary spine during the window to avoid packet-loss during ARP relearns. Ops, can we change the route with low-risk?
marta: Yes. Sequence: 1) increase hot-reserve; 2) enable secondary egress path (BGP prep); 3) cohort cordon/drain/reboot; 4) kv cache seeding; 5) demote hot-reserve. Abort conditions: if pod-eviction rate > 4% or p95 API latency increases >250ms for two consecutive cohorts.
```
# runbook excerpt
increase-reserve --pool us-east-hot --nodes 10
apply-bgp-prep --as-path bias secondary-spine --dry-run
for cohort in cohort-list:
  cordon $cohort --grace 240
  drain $cohort --delete-emptydir --ignore-daemonsets
  reboot $cohort
  run smoke-tests --tags latency,kvseed
```

kai: Cost check: keeping 10 hot nodes for 2.5h + temporary preemptible burst ~ $1.2k. Finance flagged anything over $1k requires signoff. @opsbot please create FIN approval.
opsbot: Created TASK-9001 and FIN-2045. Notified finance@redwood.
diego: Canary plan: pick 3 low-traffic tenants and one internal canary. We'll watch queue length, p50/p95, kernel dmesg for OOMs. I'll post canary names later.
anna: Also add smart-routing delta: if queue latency >120ms for EU-origin requests, route-origin-based fallback to eu-west pool. This prevents long queuing for EU traffic while us-east recovers.
marta: Good. SRE oncall (kai) will monitor metrics and has authority to abort. We'll run a BGP prep test at T-45m and a dry-run cordon at T-30m on a single rack.
kai: I'll run the smoke and check tail latencies. If anything looks off I abort and revert BGP.
diego: Reminder: update status page and post a short customer message with explicit note for reserved/dedicated customers. Keep messaging: "Planned maintenance - possible brief latency and evictions; no data loss."
marta: Final prep: confirm canary list, FIN approval, and ops oncall ready. Final check at T-60. If all green, begin at 03:00 UTC. :vertical_traffic_light:
